description:
Spacious Solar-Equipped Home in Temple, TX

Welcome to 9013 Sage Valley, a 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home in the Village of Sage Meadows. This home features an open layout with vinyl plank flooring, recessed lighting, and ceiling fans throughout. The kitchen includes modern appliances, plenty of cabinet space, and a cozy dining area.

The primary suite offers a walk-in closet, garden tub, separate shower, and dual vanities. Two additional bedrooms and bathrooms provide space for family, guests, or a home office.

Enjoy the covered porch and fenced backyard—great for relaxing or entertaining. The home also includes washer/dryer connections, central HVAC, and eco-friendly solar panels for energy savings.

Located just minutes from shopping, dining, and major highways, this home blends comfort, convenience, and sustainability.
